name: KoroneProxy
description: A reverse proxy for pekora.zip APIs with CSRF handling, cookie forwarding, subdomain support and 404 redirect.

KEY.description: The key used to access the proxy.

TIMEOUT.description: The number of seconds before a request times out and is retried.

RETRIES.description: The maximum number of times to attempt a request. Minimum: 1

PORT.description: The port the server listens on.
